about.title: About us
body: We rent private pool villas by the night, mainly in Pattaya and Jomtien, with houses in Hua Hin, Khao Yai and Phuket.
Every villa listed here is one we manage. The availability you see is the live calendar our staff and in-network agents work from, not a copy updated later.
The prices you see depend on the link you arrived through. Following an agent’s link shows that agent’s prices and puts you in touch with them directly.

contact.title: Contact us
body: Ask about dates, prices or more photos. LINE or phone, any day.

items.a: Choose a villa and your dates, fill in your details, and the dates are held for thirty minutes. Transfer the deposit, upload the slip, and our staff check it and confirm.
Thirty per cent of the total, with the balance due on arrival. A few villas differ; the real figure is shown before you book.
The deposit is not refundable once paid. To move your dates, contact us and we will see what is possible.
It is held separately from the rental, is not part of the total, and is returned at check-out if nothing is damaged.
Children under ten sharing with a guardian stay free up to each villa’s quota. Beyond that, the extra-guest fee applies per person per night.
Usually 2pm in and before noon out. Each villa’s actual times are on its page.

terms.title: Booking terms
body: A booking is complete when the deposit is paid and our staff confirm it. Before that the dates are only held, and the hold expires.
The price on your confirmed booking is the price that binds, even if the rate on the site changes afterwards.
Guests follow each villa’s house rules as published on its page, including the maximum number of guests, the pet policy and the noise policy.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: We keep your name, phone number, email and LINE ID to confirm the booking and to reach you during your stay. Nothing else.
Payment slips are kept to verify payment. They are re-encoded before storage, which removes the location data a phone photograph carries.
We do not sell or pass your details to third parties. An agent you reached through a referral link sees only bookings made through their own link.
To have your details deleted, contact us through any of the channels on the contact page.
